name: Character Skin Change Scroll
description:
Change the skin of your character.

**How To Use**
When you use this item, the skin change window will open. Select the skin you want and click the confirm button.

**Restriction**
Please unequip your defences and extention slots if you want to change the skin.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
